phases.name: The Second Wave
phases.say: Horns on the ridge. More of them.

phases.name: The Last Wave
phases.say: The whole Pit is at the gate.

say.open: Something huge moves behind the warband, and the Recruits part to let it through.
say.death: It falls against the wall, and the wall holds.

bestiary.lore: Something of the Unknown wearing a beast of the Pit like armor, driving the first warband to the settlement's gate.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, and its head: aimed blows there land half again as hard. Kill the Recruits before it eats them.
bestiary.pattern: Gores two columns deep and tramples three rows at a time. Every few turns it howls, and every Scion loses Sanity. Wounded, it devours a Recruit to heal. At two thirds and one third a fresh wave of Recruits comes over the ridge, and in the last wave it speeds up and eats whenever it can.
